whatIs: A generator of animated backgrounds made with CSS only. You choose between three styles (blurred bokeh-like bubbles, rectangles that rotate and turn into circles, and cubes that grow and fade) and adjust quantity, size, speed and colors with a live preview.
When you're done you copy the HTML and CSS from its tabs. It's a good fit when you want an animated background without JavaScript or libraries.
uses: Putting a moving bubble background in a landing page hero.
Giving a login or 404 error page a subtle animated background.
Trying out color and speed combinations before taking the CSS to your project.
caveats: Continuous animations with many elements can drain battery and resources on mobile; lower the quantity before copying.
If the animation will always be visible, add a prefers-reduced-motion rule yourself for people who ask for less motion.
There are three fixed styles; for anything different you'll have to edit the CSS by hand.
pricingNote: Free to use; it only offers optional donations and sponsorship.
idealFor: Anyone who needs a pure CSS animated background, quickly and with no dependencies.
